title: Mixed Reasoning Assessment Sets
tagline: Year 4 — A full mix of reasoning question types in one set: series, coding, ranking, direction, relations, calendar and logic

introduction.overview: Company reasoning sections mix many small question types: number series, coding-decoding, ranking, direction sense, blood relations, calendars, clocks, simple syllogisms and short puzzles. Each type has a standard method that takes under a minute once practised. This chapter gives a mixed set and the method for each type so that you can switch quickly.
introduction.placementRelevance: The first half of most reasoning sections is this kind of quick item; scoring well here buys time for puzzles.
introduction.realWorldContext: Switching quickly between small analytical tasks is typical of day-to-day work.

learningObjectives: Apply the standard method for each type
Compute ranks, directions and calendars without diagrams where possible
Solve truth-teller puzzles by case testing

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Ranks: total = rank from left + rank from right − 1. Calendar: days ahead mod 7. Direction: track coordinates.

coreDefinitions: Coding: letters or numbers changed by a fixed rule.
Rank from both ends: total = left + right − 1.
Odd days: remainder of days when divided by 7.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: Every small type has one trick. The skill is recognising which.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Name the type, apply the trick, verify once, move on.

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Letter shift
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Add or subtract k from each letter

mainNarrative: A row of 40 has Ravi 12th from the left. From the right he is 40 − 12 + 1 = 29th.
In a code CAT becomes DBU: each letter moves one step forward. So DOG becomes EPH.
A walks 6 m north and 8 m east: the distance from the start is √(36 + 64) = 10 m.
If the 5th of a month is a Monday, the 23rd is 18 days later; 18 mod 7 = 4, so Friday.
For truth-teller puzzles, assume each person in turn is truthful and test for contradiction.

deepDiveAspects.title: Series types
deepDiveAspects.content: Check differences, then differences of differences, then ratios, then squares and cubes.

deepDiveAspects.title: Case testing
deepDiveAspects.content: With three speakers there are only eight truth assignments; test them systematically.

solvedExamples.title: Ranking
solvedExamples.question: Ravi is 12th from the left in a row of 40. What is his rank from the right?

solvedExamples.title: Coding
solvedExamples.question: In a code CAT is DBU. What is DOG?

solvedExamples.title: Calendar
solvedExamples.question: The 5th of a month is a Monday. What day is the 23rd?

traditionalVsShortcut.shortcutMethod: Name the type, apply its trick, verify once, and move on.

placementTips.eliminationTechnique: Reject answers that violate an obvious constraint.
placementTips.questionSelectionAdvice: Practise each type until under 40 s.

selfCheckQuestions: Can I name the type quickly?
